# Which sums of 1/(2ⁿ − 1) are irrational?

> Which sums of 1/(2ⁿ − 1) are irrational?, by Will Cook, read beside its Lean. Made by Will Cook using AI. He built and directed the research; AI agents did most of the research, the drafting and the Lean, and no independent mathematician has reviewed the papers.

The links from the papers to the Lean, the plain titles, the reading notes and the comparisons were made with AI. No mathematician has reviewed them.
